description: [WORD · internal] The storyboards — the common narratives charted in the Bible FIRST (exile-and-return, the barren woman bears, down-to-the-pit-raised, the great reversal...), each instance real people with verified refs. The 17 movements are one shared vocabulary, so components isolate and recombine: pass movement='testing' to walk it across every storyboard. Pass id for one storyboard; else the index. FRAMING, always: a person may display characteristics of many of these at times of their life — a reference point, NEVER an identity assignment.
name: narratives
